sources.title: t5-11b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview t5-11b is an 11-billion-parameter text-to-text transformer developed by google-t5 that reframes all NLP tasks into a unified text-to-text format where both input and output are text strings. This model supports English, French, Romanian, and German and is built on the T5 framework published in the Journal of Machine Learning Research. sources.title: KerasFormers (kerasformers) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This organization hosts pre-converted Keras 3 weights for kerasformers. Each repo holds the converted model plus its tokenizer and config files, so you download once and load directly, no on-the-fly conversion, no transformers or torch runtime on the model path. Every model is a pure-Keras port that runs unchanged on all three backends.
